records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Willow Collective!
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 and admin is responsive and positive [email:0ca9b617], but no invite after two nudges [email:869e1358, email:ae6ac06f] and an open ticket about repeated logouts losing work (tick_071b44de7a4c) is friction. 8 days left on Starter; moderate-low unaided odds.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

Glad to hear things are going well and thanks for the update. I also saw your ticket about being logged out mid-edit and losing work -- that one's open with our team, and I'm keeping an eye on it.

On the layout: once your project is in place, the usual next step is getting a teammate in alongside you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Happy to walk through that first invite with you on a short call this week if that's easier -- just say the word.

Best,
Priya
